local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos

local function update(input)
    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
    Frame.Position = UDim2.new(
        startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
        startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
    )
end

TitleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = Frame.Position

        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

TitleBar.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        update(input)
    end
end)

local function scanRemotes()
    local remotes = {}
    local function findRemotesIn(parent)
        for _, child in pairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("RemoteEvent") or child:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                table.insert(remotes, child)
            end
            findRemotesIn(child)
        end
    end
    findRemotesIn(Workspace)
    findRemotesIn(ReplicatedStorage)
    return remotes
end

local remotes = scanRemotes()

local function createButton(text, sizeX, sizeY)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Text = text
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, sizeX, 0, sizeY)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
    btn.TextSize = 12
    btn.AutoButtonColor = true
    return btn
end

local function updateRemoteList(filter)
    filter = filter:lower()
    for _, child in pairs(ScrollFrame:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Frame") then child:Destroy() end
    end

    local filtered = {}
    for _, remote in pairs(remotes) do
        if remote.Name:lower():find(filter) then
            table.insert(filtered, remote)
        end
    end

    for index, remote in pairs(filtered) do
        local remoteFrame = Instance.new("Frame", ScrollFrame)
        remoteFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 32)
        remoteFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)
        remoteFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
        remoteFrame.LayoutOrder = index

        local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", remoteFrame)
        nameLabel.Text = remote.Name
        nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.35, 0, 1, 0)
        nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        nameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
        nameLabel.TextSize = 13
        nameLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        nameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 0)

        local fireBtn = createButton("Fire", 45, 24)
        fireBtn.Parent = remoteFrame
        fireBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.38, 0, 0.12, 0)

        local backdoorBtn = createButton("Backdoor", 60, 24)
        backdoorBtn.Parent = remoteFrame
        backdoorBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.53, 0, 0.12, 0)

        local copyBtn = createButton("Copy", 50, 24)
        copyBtn.Parent = remoteFrame
        copyBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.72, 0, 0.12, 0)

        fireBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                remote:FireServer()
            elseif remote:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                pcall(function() remote:InvokeServer() end)
            end
        end)

        copyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            local code = ("game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'):WaitForChild('%s'):FireServer()"):format(remote.Name)
            pcall(function() setclipboard(code) end)
        end)
    end

    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
    ScrollFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, UIListLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 8)
end

SearchBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
    updateRemoteList(SearchBox.Text)
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local farmingActive = false
local isResetting = false 
local activeTarget = nil
local lastJumpDodge = 0
local selectedPlayer = nil

-- Target Acquisition
local function getClosestPlayer()
    if isResetting then return nil end 
    local closestPlayer = nil
    local shortestDistance = math.huge
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    
    if myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        local myRoot = myChar.HumanoidRootPart
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
                local enemyHumanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if enemyHumanoid.Health > 0 and not player.Character:FindFirstChild("IsInSafeZone") then
                    local distance = (player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
                    if distance < shortestDistance then
                        shortestDistance = distance
                        closestPlayer = player
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return closestPlayer
end

-- Real-time Animation Scanner
local function isTargetSlapping(targetChar)
    if not targetChar then return false end
    local humanoid = targetChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid then
        local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or humanoid
        for _, track in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
            local animName = track.Name:lower()
            local animId = track.Animation and track.Animation.AnimationId or ""
            if animName:find("slap") or animName:find("swing") or animId:find("94025") or animId:find("1154") then
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

-- Heartbeat Physics Frame Engine Loop Connection
local Connection
Connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not ScreenGui or not ScreenGui.Parent then
        if Connection then Connection:Disconnect() end
        return
    end
    
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not myChar or not myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or not myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return end
    
    local myRoot = myChar.HumanoidRootPart
    local myHumanoid = myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    
    -- ANTI-VOID SAFETY NET SYSTEM (FIXED: Handles cooldown asynchronously to prevent game thread freezing)
    if myRoot.Position.Y < -10 and not isResetting then
        isResetting = true
        activeTarget = nil
        myRoot.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        myHumanoid:MoveTo(myRoot.Position)
        myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 50, 0) -- Teleport safely onto middle arena floor
        
        task.spawn(function()
            task.wait(1.0)
            isResetting = false
        end)
    end
    
    -- ATTACK AND HUNT MANIPULATION ENGINE
    if farmingActive and not isResetting then
        activeTarget = getClosestPlayer()
        if activeTarget and activeTarget.Character and activeTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local targetRoot = activeTarget.Character.HumanoidRootPart
            local currentDistance = (targetRoot.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
            local targetIsAttacking = isTargetSlapping(activeTarget.Character)
            
            myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(myRoot.Position, Vector3.new(targetRoot.Position.X, myRoot.Position.Y, targetRoot.Position.Z))
            
            if currentDistance <= 11 and targetIsAttacking then
                -- Direct Vector Physics Jump-Dodge Injection
                local escapeDirection = (myRoot.Position - targetRoot.Position).Unit
                myRoot.Velocity = (escapeDirection * 45) + Vector3.new(0, 35, 0)
                if tick() - lastJumpDodge > 0.4 then
                    myHumanoid.Jump = true
                    lastJumpDodge = tick()
                end
            else
                -- Predictive Chasing Paths
                local leadTime = 0.15
                local predictedPosition = targetRoot.Position + (targetRoot.Velocity * leadTime)
                if currentDistance > 7.5 then
                    myHumanoid:MoveTo(predictedPosition)
                else
                    -- Tight High-Frequency Circle Flanking Weave
                    local backAnchor = targetRoot.CFrame.LookVector * -2.0
                    local waveJitter = math.sin(tick() * 18) * 2.0
                    local strafeAnchor = targetRoot.CFrame.RightVector * waveJitter
                    myHumanoid:MoveTo(targetRoot.Position + backAnchor + strafeAnchor)
                end
            end
            
            -- Activation Hitbox Trigger Spam
            if currentDistance <= 9.0 and not targetIsAttacking then
                local glove = myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
                if glove then
                    glove:Activate()
                else
                    local backupGlove = LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
                    if backupGlove then
                        backupGlove.Parent = myChar
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

    AvatarImage.Image = "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. targetPlayer.UserId .. "&w=150&h=150"

    for _, child in ipairs(ListScroll:GetChildren()) do

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer then

            PlayerRow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(26, 26, 32)

            local rowCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
            rowCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
            rowCorner.Parent = PlayerRow
            
            PlayerRow.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() openPlayerPage(player) end)
        end

end

-- Navigation Tab Logic Switches
NavPlayersBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    ContainerFarm.Visible = false
    ContainerPlayers.Visible = true
    NavPlayersBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 30)
